verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an official CLI that calls the Channel3 API from a terminal or script. It supports image search from a URL or local file, and output formatting and field extraction with JMESPath, which suits scripted and agentic workflows. A probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page. Missing for 10: installation and auth details for the CLI, breadth of command coverage beyond search, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
